correctness.rationale: For Q=[0,1]^2 with l1 and real F_p(V), a finite mass molecule norm equals the minimum over edge flows of sum (distance*absolute flow)^p; concavity t^p for p<=1 eliminates circulations until support is a spanning tree. Every four-vertex spanning tree (16 in total) was enumerated with exact rational cut flows. Bilinearity yields the exact midpoint secant identity r(z)-r(zprime)=Dr((z+zprime)/2)(z-zprime); reflections reduce directions to s,t>=0,s+t=1. Coefficients alpha=s(1-b), beta=sb, gamma=t(1-a),eta=ta on square edges admit two cycle eliminations; among the two nonnegative three-edge representations some coefficient >=1/2. Thus a feasible 3-vector majorizes (1/2,1/4,1/4), and concavity gives norm^p<=2(1/4)^p+(1/2)^p. At (a,b)=(1/4,1/4), (s,t)=(1/2,1/2) masses are (-3/4,1/4,1/4,1/4); exact 16-tree exhaustive comparison has componentwise minimal cost triple (1/4,1/4,1/2), attaining the upper bound for every 0<p<=1. Independent 16-tree exact rational enumeration and all seven profiles were verified; 775 finite cycle tests are diagnostics, not substituted for continuum proof.
